caption: The drawing depicts a long, curved wooden table with six tapered, turned legs and three drawers. The table is colored in shades of reddish-brown, with brass or gold-colored handles on the drawers. Above the table, there are five individual design elements drawn in black and gray tones, including two types of column capitals, a vertically ribbed cylindrical element, a brass or metal drawer pull seen from the front, and a rectangular wooden design featuring a central oval pattern and a ribbed segment below it. The objects are arranged against a light beige background, with thin pencil or ink framing lines enclosing the entire composition.
title: Desk (in two sections) Used by Members of Congress
